scheduler.expiring_tomorrow_trial: ⏳ Trial ends tomorrow — but it's not over yet! 📅 End date: {date} You've tried {brand} — subscribe from 250 ₽/mo and keep your internet free 🌍 Without payment access will close — but we'll keep your key on the server for {grace_days} more days. Tap below — a couple of minutes and you're back ✨
scheduler.expiring_tomorrow_paid: 🔔 Hey, a reminder! Your {plan} plan ends tomorrow — until {date}. Renew with one tap — no need to reconfigure VPN on phone, laptop and tablet 😉
scheduler.expiring_today_trial: 🚨 Last chance! Today is the final day of trial access. Without a subscription, VPN will be disabled tonight. From 250 ₽/mo — back online without borders. Tap «Subscribe» — faster than making tea ☕️
scheduler.expiring_today_paid: ⏰ Tick-tock… Today is the last day of your {plan}. Access may disappear tomorrow morning — YouTube and your favorite shows don't deserve that 😅 Renewal takes less than a minute, same key 🔄
scheduler.expired: 💤 {label} suspended VPN is disabled — but you have {grace_days} days to return with the same key 🔄 Subscribe and everything works again without reconfiguration. In a week we'll remove the key from the server, but you'll stay with us — we'll send offers and news 📬
scheduler.grace_0: 👋 Hey, it's {brand}! Your {label} was disabled yesterday, but your key is still waiting on the server. {days_left} days left — renew and VPN comes back in a minute, no new setup ✨
scheduler.grace_1: 🌧 We miss you… {label} can still be restored — key is in place, {days_left} days left. YouTube, Instagram, favorite shows — one tap away 📱
scheduler.grace_2: ⏳ Half of grace period gone! {days_left} days until key removal from server. Then you'll need to set up again — renew now and you're good 🔑
scheduler.grace_3: 🚨 Last day! Tomorrow we'll permanently remove the {label} key from the server. Last chance to return with the same connection — after that, only a new key.
scheduler.grace_purged:
